label: No sustained power outside the thermal window; Q10 bound inside
statement_en: Under the thermal-performance hypothesis (sustained power zero outside [CTmin, CTmax], and at most P_ref Q10^((T - T_ref)/10) inside), no positive sustained power is possible outside the thermal window, and sustained power never exceeds the Q10 bound.

hypotheses.name: see theorem statement
hypotheses.statement: the named hypothesis structure(s) in the theorem statement; instantiated with fetched numbers in Delphi.Perturb.measured

scope.basis: thermal performance curves of ectotherms (Schulte 2015); Q10 values from teleost red muscle (scup, carp; Rome 1992). CTmin, CTmax, Q10 and P_ref are design inputs.

lean.source:
/-- A design claiming positive sustained power outside its thermal window is ruled out. -/
theorem thermal_rules_out (H : ThermalPerformance) {T P : ℝ} (hout : T < H.ctMin ∨ H.ctMax < T)
    (hP : P ≤ H.sustained T) (hpos : 0 < P) : False := by
  have := no_sustained_power_outside H hout hP
  linarith

named_hypotheses.name: Delphi.Perturb.ThermalPerformance
named_hypotheses.source:
/-- A thermal performance curve for sustained power: zero outside `[ctMin, ctMax]`, at most the Q10-scaled
reference inside. `sustained T` is the largest sustained power at body temperature `T`. -/
structure ThermalPerformance where
  ctMin : ℝ
  ctMax : ℝ
  tRef : ℝ
  q10 : ℝ
  pRef : ℝ
  sustained : ℝ → ℝ
  window : ctMin < ctMax
  q10_pos : 0 < q10
  pRef_nonneg : 0 ≤ pRef
  /-- Outside the thermal window there is no sustained performance. -/
  zero_outside : ∀ T, T < ctMin ∨ ctMax < T → sustained T = 0
  /-- Inside it, sustained power is at most the reference scaled by the Q10 rule. -/
  q10_inside : ∀ T, ctMin ≤ T → T ≤ ctMax → sustained T ≤ Physiology.q10Scale pRef q10 tRef T

constraint_details.canEliminate: a design that keeps swimming at a temperature outside its own thermal window

constraint_details.canEliminate: a design claiming at a cold temperature the power it has at a warm one
constraint_details.lemma_source:
/-- A design claiming more sustained power at `T` than the Q10 bound allows is ruled out. -/
theorem thermal_power_rules_out (H : ThermalPerformance) {T P : ℝ} (hP : P ≤ H.sustained T)
    (hbig : H.pRef * H.q10 ^ ((T - H.tRef) / 10) < P) : False := by
  have := sustained_power_le H hP
  linarith
